verdict.rationale: EBANX's own docs include pay-in integration guides (direct API, hosted checkout, drop-in), sandbox test cards with ready-to-use card objects, an in-browser API Reference that sends requests, and an integration prompt meant to generate runnable sandbox code snippets. That supports a docs-driven sandbox integration, but there is no evidence of copy-paste samples in multiple languages, no SDKs, and nothing showing a working flow can be built in under a day. missing for 10: documented multi-language copy-paste code samples or SDKs, evidence of under-a-day time-to-first-payment, independent or hands-on corroboration, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404)

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: Hosted checkout page managed by EBANX. You send the payment parameters, and EBANX handles the full payment flow, including UI, validation, and processing.
Each row includes a ready-to-use card object, the expected sandbox response, and a 3DS indicator
lets you fill or pre-fill card and payment fields, and sends the request directly from the API Reference.
help merchants generate accurate, runnable code snippets and setup instructions for integrating with the EBANX sandbox environment
